name: Fields
statusMeaning: Its content is data; Kiln 0.2.0 generates its structures in Horizon's worlds. Not tried in the game.
author: Nikrecs
description: Worldgen mod that adds eight farm-field structure variants to plains biomes, complete with crops, roads, irrigation, and fences.
evidence: Server-side mod: Kiln runs mods' code on Horizon's single-player server, not on dedicated servers. Data only, with 9 structure files: Kiln 0.2.0 generates structures from data in Horizon's worlds. Not tried in the game.
